'''Coris Mao''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] businessperson who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Simple. You go to their base, kill their leader, and make sure that no one will be able to use the base again.|Coris Mao, to a commando|<ref name="SWG:FD" />}}
[[File:SandPirateBase.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The [[Sand Pirate Base]].]]
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Coris Mao resided in [[Mos Entha/Legends|Mos Entha]], on the planet Tatooine.<ref name="SWG:FD" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Mao and his business associates had troubles with a local band of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] known as the [[Sand Pirates]] who hijacked transport ships in the region. Coris Mao finally contacted [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Snopel]],<ref name="SWG:FD" /> a retired [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]],<ref name="SWG:C">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Commando|Commando|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref> in order to got rid of the pirates. Snopel therefore dispatched a group of commandos under training to deal with the pirates. The commandos attacked the [[Sand Pirate Base]] near Mos Entha and killed a number of pirates. They also eliminated the pirate boss and eventually blew up the base. Coris Mao and his business associates were very satisfied with the way that matter was solved.<ref name="SWG:FD" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateFirstBrigade.jpg|275px|thumb|Every possible depictions of Coris Mao]]
Coris Mao was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FD" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Coris Mao was added to the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
